# Growth Concept Development Services (GCDS)

> GCDS is a strategic business networking and events company founded by Luke Griffin, drawing on nearly 30 years of event and exhibition experience. GCDS plans and manages events, strategic partnerships, and community programs that drive sustainable growth for businesses across Australia, including the Shellharbour & Beyond Networking Group and the Suburban Business Summit series.

GCDS works across four areas: Community (programs and events that strengthen local connection and wellbeing), Commercial (unlocking new revenue-generating markets, clients, and opportunities), Collaborators (connecting businesses with strategic partners, suppliers, and distributors), and Events & Activations (creating experiences that build connection, visibility, and impact).
